# Throttled In Bond

> Throttled In Bond is a small, independent, founder-operated American whiskey brand producing allocated, single-barrel, cask-strength, non-chill-filtered releases. Every bottle carries a proprietary VIN-TAGe code that traces it to its exact barrel, proof, age, and origin. The brand celebrates American muscle car culture under the tagline "The Spirit of American Muscle."

## Products (Inaugural Release, Generation 1, 2026)

- Founders Select: 6-year single-barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, cask strength (117.8 proof), non-chill-filtered. Suggested retail 69.99 USD. VIN-TAGe TIB 26 FS G1 00001.
- Collection Series: 6-year single-barrel high-rye bourbon finished in a rum cask, cask strength (108.2 proof), non-chill-filtered. Suggested retail 84.99 USD. VIN-TAGe TIB 26 CS G1 00002.
- Barn Find: 11-year single-barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. Suggested retail 149.99 USD. Coming Fall 2026. VIN-TAGe TIB 26 BF G1 00003.

All expressions are single barrel, cask strength, and non-chill-filtered. Releases are allocated and limited (typically around 25 cases per barrel).

## Where to buy

Sold and shipped by Bourbon Outfitter, a licensed retailer that ships to 42 U.S. states (all except AL, AR, KY, MA, MS, SD, UT, and VT). Throttled In Bond Spirits, LLC does not sell alcohol directly to consumers.
- Founders Select: https://bourbonoutfitter.com/products/throttled-in-bond-founders-select
- Collection Series: https://bourbonoutfitter.com/products/throttled-in-bond-collection-series

## VIN-TAGe provenance system

Each bottle's VIN-TAGe code (format TIB YY SS G# #####) decodes to the barrel, proof, age, origin, and mash bill of that specific bottle. Decode a bottle at https://www.throttledinbond.com/decoder
